I verified no controls in this PR. The changelog only describes the stated changes, and the corresponding code changes (v8 to v9 normalization, MLX/SDK pin moves, new model admission) are outside these units. The head-side range at the top of CHANGELOG.md (lines 6-662) covers the new v0.10.0 candidate section, which is not in the supplied units. - provider-version floors for Super and GLM-5.3-Flash;
- the cache-scope attachment only when prompt contracts match.
